scenes.title: Realtors in Jamaica: your overseas buyer asks what it'll rent for. Answer in seconds.
scenes.vo: Realtors in Jamaica: your buyer in London asks what a place will rent for. Answer in seconds.
No more pulling comps by hand while your buyer waits.

In the Deal Analyser, pick the parish and bedrooms. For a two-bed in Kingston and St Andrew, it shows a median rent of thirteen hundred and eighty-seven US dollars a month, from three hundred and ninety-two listings.
Then show yield and cashflow in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. DM me Realtor if interested in a Realtor plan.
Run your own numbers free with the APG Deal Analyser, in pounds, US dollars or Jamaican dollars. Link in my bio.
